added_failures_note: The reviewed manifest records no base log and no head log: its baseline_suite and after_suite fields are empty and its negative_control is 'none: a measurement whose verdict is read from solver termination records, not from a check it writes'. The node is docs-only and its diff changes no source, so there is no suite arm to reduce and zero added failures is the derived figure rather than an unmeasured one.

findings.text: The sentence 'Their 340 cell locations match within 7.4e-13 m under nearest-neighbour matching, but cell ordering and total solve-coordinate count differ (1536 on CPU, 1547 on H200), so the two receipts do not isolate device arithmetic as the cause of that gap' is not reproducible from anything the run persisted. No script or log in the run directory computes the 7.4e-13 figure, and the only coordinate sets in the receipts (render_data.coordinates_rz_m) give a nearest-neighbour maximum of 4.274211833313678e-12 m, an order of magnitude larger; the count difference is also not a carrier difference, because the H200 row's array carries 11 exactly duplicated rows and both arrays hold 1536 unique coordinates that agree to 5.0e-12 m when sorted. The caveat may still hold for another reason, but as written it asserts an unreproducible measurement and overstates how far the two carriers differ; correct the number from a persisted computation, or state the duplicate-row origin and drop the count claim.

The tracked edb02142 receipt is described as reporting 'residual 5.626976272072871e-15 after two trips, and converged', but that receipt's own qualification verdict is 'unqualified' with reason topology_read_does_not_admit_required_stationary_points (git show edb02142:docs/figures/gs-absolute-accuracy/solovev/production-route-parts/diverted-single-null-production-route-cells-300.json). Section 4 needs a qualified row before the certificate is re-committed, so reporting only 'converged' lets a reader take the historical row as qualification-ready when it is not.

Lines 3, 6-7 and 11 restate values already committed in the sibling record docs/evidence/fragments/topology-read-containment-and-rebank/certificate-drift-attribution.html -- the 2.2640848763056183 CPU residual, the 1536-versus-1547 counts, both target currents and the 5.626976272072871e-15 tracked receipt -- without citing it, so the same numbers are now recorded twice and can drift apart; reference the sibling record or say which fragment is authoritative for the shared values.
